text:
maria: Heads-up — invoice-preview shows a drift for 3 tenants after yesterday's routing-policy rollout. numbers off by ~2-7% on token counts :eyes:
sam: Which pipeline? preview or final invoice? have logs?
maria: preview and final. Preview UI shows lower charges, backend final is higher. attaching quick tail from event-collector: ```WARN dedupe: seen duplicate event id=evt_0a9f tenant=acme tokens=420```
lee: that log looks like duplicate ingestion, probably dedupe-window too short or id reuse from the proxy. we increased window last quarter but maybe routing fanout changed.
rahul: can we confirm where dedupe happens? edge proxy currently sets `event_id`, pipeline consumer relies on that id for dedupe. are we trusting upstream IDs?
sam: we do. edge assigns `event_id = sha256(request_body + timestamp)` so low collision but after routing changes some clients are getting retried and proxy sometimes replays with same id?
ashley: product concern: customers are seeing inconsistent preview vs bill. we need a mitigation that doesn't require full replay. can we surface a console banner and a preview disclaimer?
finance-bot: Observed invoice deltas: tenant acme +$1,240, tenant beta -$320, tenant gamma +$85. ETA for fix affects reconciliation cutoff.
maria: ingest-bot just posted a metric: `ingest_consumer_lag=120s` and `duplicate_rate=0.004` — spike aligns with rollout timeframe.
ingest-bot: deploy: consumer-group metering-consumer-v2 scaled from 4->8 at 2024-11-07T03:12:40Z due to routing intensity.
lee: quick theory: routing fanout multiplied events to multiple shards and our per-shard dedupe windows were independent -> duplicates cross-shard. dedupe should be centralized or use a deterministic partitioning on `event_id`.
rahul: two options: 1) central dedupe store (redis) with strong consistency (costly/latency), 2) deterministic partitioning keyed by `tenant_id:event_id` so same event lands on same shard. prefer #2 for perf.
sam: #2 requires changing the proxy route key, might be a small config deploy but risk during rollout (could reorder events).
lee: also consider longer dedupe TTL (from 5m -> 1h) as temporary mitigation. cheap but keeps more state.
ashley: product ok with temporary TTL if we notify customers and freeze preview refreshes for affected tenants. want minimal visible churn.
rahul: agree. plan: 1) increase dedupe TTL to 60m (hotfix), 2) add telemetry to detect cross-shard duplicate counts, 3) schedule partitioning work for next sprint with a canary.
sam: I'll open PR to extend TTL and add a metric `dedupe_cross_shard_rate`. tagging @lee for review.
lee: will add alert: `rate > 1e-3` over 5m -> page oncall. also add dashboard card to console preview with `preview vs final delta` for tenants.
ashley: I'll push a small console banner and a preview disclaimer for affected tenants. also prep customer comms template.
finance-bot: Please include an incident tag `billing-delta-2024-11-07` on any follow-ups so accounting can trace adjustments.
rahul: one internal API debate: should metering clients include `ingest_idempotency_key` generated client-side (owner: clients) or proxy keep generating server-side? If clients own it we avoid proxy reuse issues but risk bad clients. Thoughts?
sam: prefer proxy-generated id to keep a standard, but we need stronger server-side guarantees (partition key + stable id). if we move to client-side, we must validate and dedupe differently.
lee: compromise: accept client-supplied `client_event_id` if present; otherwise fall back to proxy id. validate format and length. that reduces pressure immediately and doesn't break existing clients.
maria: thanks. I'm going to start the TTL hotfix now. Opening a thread in eng-oncall for the page if alerts fire.
sam: PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/meters/pulls/482 — patch extends dedupe TTL and emits cross_shard metric.
lee: LGTM, will merge and deploy to canary then prod. adding e2e: send same event via 3 proxies and assert consumer dedupes to 1 record.
ashley: created console banner draft in product console -> banners -> billing-preview. will push after canary looks stable.
rahul: scheduling partitioning design doc for Monday's arch sync. assign to eng-platform + eng-runtime.
maria: action items summarized: sam patch TTL + metric, lee add alert + e2e, ashley banner + comms, rahul design doc. will reconvene in 2 hours. :thumbsup:
finance-bot: Note: accounting will hold invoice finalization for affected tenants until grace period applied. request id #BIL-20241107-1
ashley: also want a UX toggle for 'freeze preview' per-tenant in console for future rollouts. filing feature request.
maria: thanks everyone. posting logs to #incidents if anyone wants raw traces.
sam: monitoring shows dup-rate dropping after canary merge. will post numbers in 15m.
lee: if dup-rate doesn't fall we fall back to temporary rate-limiting at proxy to reduce replay noise.
ashley: I'm updating customers on the status page.
maria: last: remember to annotate the rollout doc with this dedupe caveat so future routing changes consider cross-shard dedupe.
